The '''TL3 Holo-Imaging Package''' was a model of [[Holocamera/Legends|holocamera]] manufactured by [[Neuro-Saav Technologies/Legends|Neuro-Saav Technologies]] and designed specifically to work with [[Droid/Legends|droids]]. The TL3 was a small processing device that was tied into the droid's existing [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]]. It was capable of recording everything from the droid's perspective, and the information could be downloaded onto [[Datacard/Legends|datacards]], [[Dataplaque/Legends|data plaques]], and [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojectors]]. The basic model of the package was only capable of recording in [[Human/Legends|Human]]-range, but upgrades were available that allowed the droid to record in the [[Macrobinoculars/Legends|macrobinocular]] range and in three-hundred and sixty degrees.<ref name="CFTD" />
